blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine national karate squad delivered the country’s third medal in the Asian Games 2026 after beating Thailand, 4-1, in the bronze medal match of the women’s kata team event on Tuesday at Toyohashi Gymnasium. Samantha Emmanuelle Veguillas, Ysabielle Arrogante and Rebecca Cyril Torres delivered a composed performance, posting scores of 7.8, 7.7, 7.9, 8.7 and 8.1, against Thailand’s 7.6, 7.5, 7.7, 8.5 and 8.3. “I feel like it was our teamwork.
